title: Lucene Query Syntax: Write Precise Search Queries | Orchard Core
description:
Plain words in a search box often return long lists of results. The search page of an Orchard Core site reads what is typed as a Lucene query, so operators, phrases, wildcards, fields and ranges narrow the list.

This video shows how the Lucene search service parses a query, and how to write each kind of query the syntax supports, on the search page of a blog.

In this video:
• How a query is read: the parser, the default fields and the analyzer
• Boolean operators: AND, NOT, plus and minus
• Phrases and proximity searches
• Wildcards, fuzzy terms and regular expressions
• Fields, groups and ranges
• The same syntax in a query_string query
• Common mistakes
